thread:
noah: Quick check  final SEO items for tomorrow's webinar + launch posts. Need: prioritized kws, minimal JSON-LD (Event + 1 FAQ), 3 internal links from pillar -> landing, and redirect rules that preserve UTMs. Owners?

yara: I can lock the KW list and anchors. Pushed sheet: https://tiny.example/kw-4087 (top 6, intent + anchor).

ben: I'll do redirects + smoke tests. Reminder: keep querystrings and fragments. Will open a PR with nginx examples.

seo-bot: scan: 4 pages missing Event structured data, 2 duplicate meta descriptions. report: https://tiny.example/scan4087

noah: Yara, paste the anchor suggestions here. Ben, paste the nginx snippet we'll use. Keep FAQ one short Q: "Who should attend?"

yara: Anchors: "inference latency", "serving LLMs at scale", "reduce per-token cost". UTM template: ?utm_source=post&utm_campaign=webinar_launch

ben: nginx snippets: ```nginx
# preserve qs
rewrite ^/blog/2026/(.*)-webinar$ /webinars/serving-llms?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=webinar_launch permanent;
location = /resources/webinar { return 301 /webinars/serving-llms; }
```

noah: Good. For JSON-LD keep it compact. Yara can drop into the landing branch and Ben will verify via unit test. Seo-bot recommended FAQ + rel=canonical self on landing.

yara: I'll add JSON-LD (Event + 1 FAQ) and anchor mapping in the sheet. Example JSON-LD: ```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"WebPage","mainEntity":{"@type":"Event","name":"Serving LLMs at Scale","startDate":"2026-03-26T16:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.example/webinars/serving-llms"},"@graph":[{"@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"Who should attend?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Platform and ML engineers building inference."}}]}]}
```

ben: I'll include smoke tests in PR: curl -I check for 301, verify rel=canonical header, and quick GA event sanity on register CTA. Canary first, full rollout after QA.

noah: Timeline recap: redirects PR by 15:00, JSON-LD + anchors by 16:00, messaging locked by 17:30, QA by 20:00. Go-live tomorrow 09:00 PT. Flag any blockers here. :rocket:

seo-bot: recommendation: set rel=canonical on old pages to the new landing and limit FAQ to one Q to reduce markup noise.

yara: All good from content side.

ben: No blockers; will ping eng-infra for reload window.

noah: Thanks team  posting PR links here when ready.
